notes: Current effective Marsannay AOC production paths. The 2026 Premier Cru project is not effective law and is deliberately absent. Accessory red/rose grape rules that are only safe as an aggregate 15% cap are conservatively omitted from the positive blend path until aggregate accessory constraints are first-class.

marsannay_masa_2020_current.scope: Published current Marsannay cahier des charges, modified by the order of 26 November 2019 and published in the BO Agri 28 May 2020: three colors, encépagement, maturity, yields, analytical limits, vineyard rules, cellar practices, élevage, release and smaller-geographic-unit labeling conditions.

specs.notes: Current village white path. Pinot Gris is capped at 30% in the wine blend. The conditional 4 g/L fermentable-sugar allowance requires a total-acidity predicate and is not generalized; the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling is used.

Conservative current red positive path. Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are accessory grapes subject to a combined 15% blend ceiling; they are withheld rather than incorrectly modeled as three independent 15% allowances.

Current rosé positive path using the two principal grapes. Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc are legal accessory grapes subject to a combined 15% ceiling and are conservatively withheld until aggregate accessory constraints are executable. The cahier sends rosé release to Code rural D.645-17; no June 30 gate is invented for rosé.
